key_impacts: Harbor break walls submerged and waves flooded the shoreline and into city streets near Ludington.
Damage occurred to shoreline homes, public docks, and cottages.
Water intake pumps were impacted due to the large change in water level.
Reports indicated water level fluctuations of about 2 m along the coastline just outside the harbor.
The Ludington harbor gauge recorded water level fluctuations up to 0.5 m.
